headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 3, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals took down the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1, while the Cleveland Guardians shut out the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin, who has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left flexor strain. The Tampa Bay Rays placed RF Jake Fraley on the 60-day injured list with a hernia, while the Toronto Blue Jays placed 2B Lenyn Sosa on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion.

The New York Mets made a midseason move, trading RHP Huascar Brazobán to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for RHP Gabe Davis and RHP Zach Franklin. The Los Angeles Angels traded RHP José Soriano to the Toronto Blue Jays for SS Arjun Nimmala, RF Eddie Micheletti Jr. and RHP Angel Rivero. The Washington Nationals traded 1B Luis García Jr. to the New York Yankees for RHP Ben Grable, RHP Yovanny Cruz, RHP Jack Cebert and RHP Jake Bird.

top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-4 decision to the Atlanta Braves, unable to overcome a strong Braves performance. Mike Yastrzemski led the Nationals with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to secure a win.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense and Matthew Liberatore pitching a strong 6.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall to Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Patrick Bailey led the Diamondbacks' offense with a home run, one RBI, and three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Nationals' PJ Poulin Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Make Midseason Move**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets traded RHP Huascar Brazobán to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for RHP Gabe Davis and RHP Zach Franklin.
